_comment: PRODUCTION stage 2 (long-unroll fine-tune with the long-jump term) - loads stage-1 best.ckpt (best val_loss,
published by src/main.py only when stage 1 finished, i.e. wrote COMPLETED; EMA weights
preferred automatically by the weights_only loader).
Model block is IDENTICAL to stage 1.
Recipe: every step runs skip_steps = 81 no-grad steps from the window start (pushforward), then trains the
following steps by BPTT, every trained step weighted equally: the curriculum raises the horizon from 82 to
rollout_steps = 90 over 5 epochs (1 to 9 trained steps). The rollout state is carried in float64
(precision.input_dtype; the network runs in float32). Each step also adds the long-jump term (training.loss).
Schedule: a fixed step budget of 50 epochs x 1000 steps = 50,000 optimizer steps; LR warmup 1 epoch, then a
cosine from training.optimizer.lr to min_lr_fraction x that peak at the last step; no early stopping.
val_loss is the 90-step open loop scored on steps >= 81, a diagnostic.
Stage 2 reuses the stage-1 processed shards; do NOT rerun preprocessing.
Run: AUTOCHEM_CONFIG_PATH=configs/stage2.json python -u src/main.py

precision._comment: amp_mode "true" = Lightning 32-true: no autocast (required for float32 compute); only "mixed" enables autocast. TF32 is allow_tf32 (forced off by runtime.deterministic=true). input_dtype float64: batches are cast to float64, so the rollout state is carried in float64 (the shards stay float32).

_comment: Identical to stage 1 EXCEPT overwrite=false, the sole intended difference:
stage 2 reuses the same processed shards (../data/processed); do NOT rerun
preprocessing for stage 2 (overwrite=false is the guard).

dataset._comment: Epoch by count, a fixed step budget: 1000 optimizer steps per epoch and a fixed validation set of 65536 = 64 x 1024 windows (no ragged last batch; of the N_val x 10 enumerated 91-state windows). Not re-derived when data is added.

_comment: Long-jump term: every step adds jump_weight * HybridLoss(F(z(t), D), z(t + D)) on jump_batch_size pairs from
<processed_dir>/raw_trajectories (written by preprocessing), D log-uniform in [jump_min_seconds,
jump_max_seconds] s and t log-uniform where t + D stays inside the trajectory. D runs past dt_max (1000 s):
the relaxation head's network never sees dt.
